purpose: Govern aggregate product and portfolio pricing proposals from evidence through human review and post-decision realization monitoring.
allowed: Prioritize product-level price, cost-master and portfolio review work
Prepare evidence-backed pricing requests for named human reviewers
Monitor approved list-price changes against invoiced and pocket-price realization
Recommend rollback review when realized economics fall outside the approved case
prohibited: Automatically approve or publish a customer price
Represent observational elasticity as a causal price effect
Override contract terms, customer commitments or delegated approval limits
Treat forecast margin as realized financial benefit
Hide missing market coverage, unusable elasticity or master-data defects

approval_tiers.rule: Cost master is missing or unsafe
Absolute proposed change is at most 5%
Absolute proposed change is above 5% and at most 7%
Absolute proposed change exceeds 7% or the proposal is discontinuation

human_boundary: Every material price, contract or discontinuation decision remains open until the named reviewer acts outside this public demonstration.
